import asyncio


async def nested(items, session, save):
    for item in items:
        async with session.lock():
            async with session.get(item) as response:
                if response.ok:
                    return await save(item)


async def inner(items, rows, session, save):
    for item in items:
        async with session.lock():
            for row in rows:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                await save(row)
            if item:
                break


async def callback(items, session, save):
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with session.lock():

            async def finish():
                return item

            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await save(item)


async def branch(items, session):
    for item in items:
        async with session.get(item) as response:
            if not response.ok:
                continue
            else:
                break


async def raw_lambda(items):
    for batch in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*map(lambda item: save(item, True), batch))
